correctness.rationale: Exact harmonic coefficient-trace relations yield the n necessary and independent constraints. Polynomial (5) constructs a harmonic interpolant for every feasible sample vector. The normalized reproducing kernel and vertex-edge incidence representation split the finite Gram matrix into odd, pair, standard, and trivial sectors; symbolic determinant/trace equalities prove every eigenbranch for all n>=3. Branch ordering and derivative inequalities give the unique ratio minimum 15/8 at n=6. The embedded checker independently tests symbolic and rational identities and many finite dimensions, not as a replacement for the infinite proof.

The exact n incidence obstructions, constructive harmonic right inverse, complete spectrum with resonant dimensions, and unique best-conditioned dimension six settle structural recovery and numerical stability questions across an infinite root-system family.
